newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Techn names new president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Techn names new president/COO.

text.p: Industrial Technologies Inc said Monday that it has named Eric Twerdahl president and chief operating officer.
Twerdahl, a director of the company, succeeds Gerald Stewart, who remains chairman and chief executive.
Twerdahl has served as a board member since January 1996. Prior to joining the company, he was managing director of Fox, Twerdahl, Lehmann & Co, an international investment banking firm.
Industrial Technologies designs, assembles and markets automatic surface-inspection systems, electro-optical sensors and industrial computers.
